conditions.runtime: Client-side FTB Quests 2001.4.22 completion presentation only; native quest, task, reward and progress ownership remains in FTB Quests and JEMAchievementGuide.

change.summary: Present completed FTB quests in chat through the client-only In chat FTB mod and remove non-objective guide cards from visible tabs.

modifiers.before: FTB's native toast announces a completed quest without a direct chat link.
modifiers.after: The client-only in_chat_ftb mod posts one local chat line with a cyan underlined quest title that opens that exact quest in the native FTB book. The native quest panel still refreshes; server progress and reward logic are unchanged.

modifiers.before: Informational reference cards, chapter captions and free-standing tab text are visible around authored objectives.
modifiers.after: Reference cards and free-standing captions are omitted from visible chapters while authored source history, stable objective identities, tasks, rewards and quest-page descriptions remain.

cause.owner: In chat FTB client presentation and JEMAchievementGuide quest projection

rationale.purpose: Keep quest completion readable and navigable without changing native quest state or introducing a second gameplay authority.
rationale.decision_source: User requested cyan clickable completed-quest titles in chat, removal of all FTb guide cards and tab text, then specified a standalone client-only mod named In chat FTB.

introduced.summary: Add client-only In chat FTB and simplify the visible questbook presentation.

history.summary: Retire old information-screen and chapter-caption sources while retaining authored objective and reward data.

relations: Native FTB Quest ID -> local clickable chat title -> native FTB quest page
JEMAchievementGuide source objectives -> visible native quests with stable progress and rewards
notes: In chat FTB is installed only on clients and declares an exact installed FTB Quests dependency.
unresolved: The rendered chat link and quest-page opening remain unobserved until the user runs the updated test jem client.
